name: conjureos-app-recipes
description: Recipes for ConjureOS: browse a catalog, keep a pantry, get suggestions ranked by what you have, and plan a week of meals that shares a shopping list.
author: Jonny-B

listRecipes.description: List the user's saved recipes, optionally filtered by title or ingredient substring. Returns title, slug, difficulty, cookTime, servings, ingredients, savedAt, madeCount, lastMadeAt, and per-serving nutrition when available.

getRecipe.description: Fetch one saved recipe by slug. Returns the full recipe including ingredients, instructions, summary, servings, and nutrition. Useful when a calorie tracker wants to log every ingredient of a meal the user cooked.

addRecipe.description: Save a recipe to the user's Recipes folder. Takes title, difficulty, cookTime, servings, ingredients, instructions, and optional summary + nutrition. Useful for meal planners pushing recipes into the user's library.

markCooked.description: Mark a saved recipe as cooked (increment madeCount, update lastMadeAt). Takes slug. Useful for calorie/health apps confirming that a meal was eaten.

promptSuggestions: Show me recipes I can make with what's in my fridge
What's quick to cook with chicken and rice?
What did I cook this week?

//: No Vite. `npm run dev` is the esbuild dev server from @conjureos/pack; the published build goes through ConjureOS @bundle in CI (same as a user-published app). Bump `version` here AND in src/version.ts together.
